mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pw_platform_ai_user_access (user_id, offering_id, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{offeringId}, CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ON CONFLICT (user_id, offering_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pw_platform_ai_user_access WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND offering_id = #{offeringId}
